title: Appliance Repair Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Facility Appliance Repair: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Appliance Repair Inspection Checklist covers commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation. The facility appliance service coordinator records Facility Appliance Repair criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Appliance Repair Inspection Checklist keeps Facility Appliance Repair exceptions visible until the facility appliance service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Appliance Repair Inspection Checklist at shared kitchen, laundry, break area, utility point, and equipment position. Document commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation identity before Facility Appliance Repair begins. Compare commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation findings with stated Facility Appliance Repair criteria; route unresolved Facility Appliance Repair issues to qualified appliance service supervisor. For Appliance Repair Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Facility Appliance Repair. Ask qualified appliance service supervisor to review Facility Appliance Repair conditions beyond the facility appliance service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Facility Appliance Repair, identify responsible parties, shared kitchen, laundry, break area, utility point, and equipment position, and the linked commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation source.

fields.label: Asset tag, make, model, serial, and appliance type
Reported symptom, error code, duty cycle, and user impact

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Facility Appliance Repair facts for commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Facility Appliance Repair inspection checks
items: Power, gas, water, drain, vent, and connection condition
Door, latch, seal, interlock, and enclosure condition
Motor, pump, fan, heater, sensor, and control behavior
Leak, drainage, airflow, temperature, and cycle result
Anchorage, leveling, clearance, and adjacent property condition
Full representative operating cycle after repair

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Facility Appliance Repair finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Facility Appliance Service Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Gas, electrical, refrigerant, water, or combustion hazard
Safe full-cycle test cannot be completed
blocks.guidance: Pause Facility Appliance Repair when a utility hazard, protective-device failure, incompatible part, or unsafe operating result remains. Retain the available Facility Appliance Repair proof and route unresolved commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation scope to facility appliance service coordinator.
